name: L.F.C Custom Apparel Printing
old_description: Thermal regulation weave. Benefit: Reduces player heat-fatigue, keeping league energy levels at peak through overtime.
about:
Limited Freedom Clothing Company, operating as L.F.C. Custom Apparel Printing, is based in Plainville, Connecticut. The company's founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in full-dye sublimation printing for sports uniforms and team apparel. Its workflow moves from design and quote through art approval, sublimation production, roster-based packing, and shipment. The company runs an online team-store platform that lets players or parents order individually while the organization manages a single storefront. Garment options include jerseys, hoodies, hats, practice gear, fan apparel, and full team bundles. Case studies cite 40-player orders completed in two weeks and a 12-team league served through one storefront.

L.F.C. serves youth and amateur sports organizations across baseball, basketball, football, soccer, softball, wrestling, volleyball, lacrosse, hockey, cheer, golf, and track. Named clients include Ironclad Baseball League, Westfield Youth Sports, Riverside Volleyball Club, Northgate Soccer Alliance, and Summit Wrestling Club. The company also works with school programs, travel clubs, recreational leagues, and corporate teams.

The business emphasizes a streamlined digital ordering experience, with standard production timelines of 21 business days and rush options down to 10 days. Reorders can ship in as few as five days. In-house design assistance, a fundraising program, and a proof-before-production workflow are offered as differentiators.
